# Steady 2.21.14

## What's new
- **Steady websites always open** — `labratkali.github.io` and `*.less-phone.workers.dev` stay on the DNS always-allow list. Parent block lists and policy sync cannot remove or shadow them.
- **Parent dashboard** — Steady sites show as locked “always on”; Save & push re-seeds them every time.
- **Website paths** — `/testing` (and other folders) redirect to a trailing slash so CSS/assets load; same on the workers.dev proxy.

## For parents
Update the kid phone, then open:
- https://labratkali.github.io/steady-web/
- https://steady.less-phone.workers.dev/
- https://steady.less-phone.workers.dev/testing/
